Built a complete, playable browser game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`. It features an interactive isometric city map, six neighborhoods to manage and expand into, community and business actions, income collection, influence and heat, a crew, and a city ledger. The layout adapts to phone and tablet screens with touch-friendly controls.

I checked the game in a browser at desktop and mobile sizes and corrected a JavaScript syntax issue during testing. The game is intentionally fictional and centers on community-building and neighborhood strategy.
